brief:
The Jewish Network for Palestine has challenged the UK's proscription of Hamas, arguing that the complete ban stifles free speech, Al Jazeera English reported. The group contends that the designation prevents open discussion and debate about the Palestinian resistance movement.

The UK classifies Hamas as a terrorist organization. The Jewish Network for Palestine's challenge highlights tensions between security measures and civil liberties protections in British law.
dek: The Jewish Network for Palestine says the complete ban on Hamas was being used to stifle free speech.
title: Jewish group challenges UK's complete ban on Hamas over free speech
